data.body: 2026-09-26 CORRECTION - supersedes 'incremental = false' in the two build-hygiene notes above. Incremental is ON again in both manifests ([profile.dev]/[profile.test]: debug = 1, incremental = true; build-override: debug = false, incremental = false). Measured on aworkit-capability-host with real builds: edit rebuild 7.7 s incremental vs 37.5 s with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, and the flavour set stayed at 16 dirs across both rebuilds, so a stable invocation matrix reuses its cache. Cost is now bounded rather than the feature removed: scripts/trim-rust-incremental.mjs prunes incremental sessions untouched for --days (default 14; --dry-run/--all), never touching deps/build/.fingerprint. Default run: nothing older than 14 days (4.6 GB / 231 entries); --days 3 would reclaim 2.9 GB. Open: deps/build stale units (no cargo GC) and churn from clippy/check/test/tauri dev.
